children: According to JPX official data, the Hong Kong Economic Times and TAIFEX, Asian index-futures firmed in overnight trading after U.S. stocks closed higher on Friday. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.2% to a record and the S&P 500 added 0.7% following the September payrolls report, though U.S. Treasury yields held elevated.

Nikkei 225 futures rose in the Osaka night session. The near-month December 2026 contract settled at 69,760 at the overnight close, up 1,110 points. The December Nikkei 225 mini contract ended at 69,710, up 1,080.

Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index futures eased in after-hours trade, with the near-month October contract closing at 23,831, down 49 points, as weaker U.S. employment data and still-high bond yields weighed. In U.S. ADR trading, HSBC's ADR rebounded 0.93% against its Hong Kong close, while JD.com's ADR fell 1.70%, Tencent's slipped 1.05%, Meituan's lost 1.01% and Alibaba's edged down 0.54%. The Hang Seng had closed the Friday cash session down 640 points at 23,972, with financials hit hard and HSBC off more than 5%.

Taiwan's TAIEX futures advanced in the night session, the near-month October contract finishing at 49,346, up 677 points or 1.39%, after briefly topping 49,000 at a session high of 49,495. The strength tracked Taiwanese chip ADRs on Wall Street: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) rose 2.96%, United Microelectronics (UMC) gained 4.20%, AU Optronics climbed 7.07% and Chunghwa Telecom added 1.34%. The TAIEX cash market had closed Friday up 122 points at 48,475.

title: ASIA NIGHT SESSION | Nikkei Night Futures Climb 1,110 Points as Wall Street Rallies; Hang Seng Futures Slip, TAIEX Futures Firm
